label: miso3 reservecoopt
definition: (PROBE) Adds the in-LP market-wide energy+operating-reserve co-optimization for MISO (scarcity.miso_reserve_coopt_inputs, the MISO analogue of the ERCOT/PJM/NYISO co-opt): requirement = fleet-derived MSSC + 400 MW regulation (~3 GW), VOLL-anchored Reliability-Based Demand Curve to $3,500/MWh, linearised to zero reserve; single footprint-wide reserve family; import node default-on. Determination NOT-YET: the mechanism is structurally correct, live, and sourced (nothing fitted), but FULLY INERT -- reserve_price is exactly $0 in all 26,280 hours, so the energy solution is identical to miso2 (C3a still -9/-17/-14%, net interchange +0.1/-7.5/+45.0 unchanged). The ~3 GW requirement never binds because the perfect-foresight LP holds tens of GW of idle thermal headroom -- the same result the PJM reserve campaign documented. Per CLAUDE.md #1/#11 the requirement was NOT inflated to manufacture scarcity; the structure stays in as the correct baseline. The level miss is carried by market-specific MISO coal offer curves + a firm-hydro (Manitoba) import block (handed off).
